_note: Owner overrides for Larry's projections. gp and mpg each replace the model's number; omit either to keep the model's. Entries past their 'until' date are ignored, so a stale note cannot quietly distort the board all season. Keyed by ESPN player id (find it in tests/fixtures/projections/espn-history.json). Prefer deleting a stale entry over letting it expire.

_schema.gp: expected games played for the season, 0 to 82
_schema.note: why, in one line, for whoever reads this next
_schema.until: YYYY-MM-DD, local. After this date the entry is ignored.

4396993.name: Tyrese Haliburton
4396993.note: Example of the shape. Not active: it lives under _example, not players.

_whyEmpty: The spec called for shipping a Haliburton override because ESPN had him projected for 1 game. ESPN has since corrected that: as of the 2026-10-14 pull he is projected for 64 games, and Larry's board already ranks him 16th without help. An override asserting a different games-played number would be a medical opinion rather than a data fix, which this file is explicitly not for. Add entries here when ESPN is wrong in a way you can point at.
